title: Withdrawn: PR71 assembly-backoff note
body:
Withdrawn in favor of [a small arithmetic note on PR #71](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/71#issuecomment-6067419855).

The construction is unchanged from PR #71. This only reduces its assembly backoff and changes κ by `1.55e-16`; it does not warrant a separate contribution PR.

The exact calculation, its cutoff tradeoff, verification status and immutable reproduction artifacts are linked in that comment. Credit remains with PR #71 and its cited predecessors. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
